name: codex-context-orb
description: Local context-health companion with a focused skill and asynchronous metadata-only lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect local lifecycle evidence and prepare a handoff.
interface.longDescription: A development-stage companion for the separate Codex Context Orb desktop app. Hooks save bounded lifecycle metadata locally; the skill explains unknown context values and helps prepare a user-requested handoff. Automatic foreground tracking and semantic health assessment are not implemented.
defaultPrompt: Check the context-health evidence for this session.
Prepare a concise handoff for a fresh session.
